entities.summary: Akbar Al Baker is a Qatari businessman who is the former CEO of Qatar Airways. He was also the chairman of Qatar Tourism until October 22, 2023. Under Qatar Airways Group, Al-Baker was also the CEO of Hamad International Airport, which opened in 2014.
